about: The catalogue behind index.json: what each real file covers, where its figures come from, the figures written in code, memory claims that now have data, the holes and the sources the cloud can't reach. Edit this file, then run scripts/build_index.py.

nfl_teams.csv.source: Wikipedia stadium and TV-market lists (Nielsen DMA 2024-25), team pages

nfl_rules.json.source: NFL.com, OverTheCap, the 2020 CBA, NFL Football Operations (URLs in the file)

rates.json.source: On3, 247Sports, ESPN recruit ratings (classes 2013-2026), NCAA portal counts, Hudl, Opendorse, SI/CBS (see README)
rates.json.holes: JUCO-to-FBS and prep-school signees per year; NIL dollars for G5, FCS and D2; D2 portal entrants; the revenue-sharing cap not verified on a page

hs_states.csv.source: MaxPreps 2026 state rankings, SI 2026 playoff guide, state association handbooks (URL per row)
hs_states.csv.holes: DC classes and playoffs blank; how teams qualify missing for most states; weaker rows AL, IL, HI, ME, MT, NE, OR, PA, VT, KS; NIL rows AR, CO, MO, TX

talent_by_state.csv.source: computed: sportsdataverse cfb_recruits + cfbfastR-data rosters + nflverse draft_picks (method in README)

colleges.csv.source: Wikipedia program and stadium lists, CFBD schedules for records, AAU and Carnegie lists (URL per figure)
colleges.csv.holes: nil_estimate_usd blank for all; stadium capacity blank for 7 D2 schools; Chicago State has no record

colleges_lower.csv.source: Wikipedia lists of NAIA, D3 and JUCO programs (URL per row)
colleges_lower.csv.holes: no records or scores (no open NAIA or JUCO results)

college_history_dropped.csv.source: Wikipedia lists of discontinued programs (URL per row)

tendency_spreads.json.source: nflverse-data releases (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases): play-by-play, Next Gen Stats, PFR advanced defense
tendency_spreads.json.holes: no public stat for reaching the ball out or keeping contain; 'outside' runs are where the run ended

college_game_targets.json.holes: no D2, D3, NAIA, JUCO or high school play by play

college_altitude.csv.source: Claude's reading of published town elevations (USGS and town pages), rounded

position_value.json.holes: snap-share bands come from published summaries, not this folder

rivalries.csv.source: Wikipedia, Winsipedia game lists, CFBD schedules (URL per row)
rivalries.csv.holes: Clemson-South Carolina 1896-1917 and six trophies' first years are 'memory' in the notes

engine_targets.json.source: nflverse-data releases (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases) (pbp, participation, FTN charting, snap counts, contracts) and nfldata games.csv

trial3_baselines.json.source: CFBD scores, ESPN recruit ratings, nflverse draft/combine/players, CFBD rosters

development_injuries.json.holes: read by no code; no college or high school injuries

nfl_history.json.source: nflverse-data releases (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases) (pbp 1999-2025, schedules, trades), nfldata standings and win totals, FiveThirtyEight nfl_games.csv (1996-1998 scores)
nfl_history.json.holes: 1996-1998 scores only (no play by play before 1999); standings from 2002; win totals 2003-2020; no attendance

nfl_careers.json.source: nflverse-data releases (https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases) (draft_picks, players, combine, contracts, rosters, stats_player)
nfl_careers.json.holes: no arm or hand sizes, no handedness, no pro-day times; contracts thin before 2011; careers from rosters start in 1999

college_history.json.source: CFBD schedules via sportsdataverse-data releases (https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases) (cfb_schedules 2001-2025), ESPN line scores 2004-2025, AP poll 2004-2025, 247Sports talent composite 2015-2025
college_history.json.holes: no college scores before 2001 (1996-2000 still a hole); FCS from 2003; D2 and D3 full seasons from 2021-2022; no NAIA or JUCO; FCS overtime too thin in ESPN line scores

college_attendance.csv.holes: a few home games carry no attendance

college_plays.json.holes: no college play by play before 2014 or below FCS; no participation (snaps, personnel, coverage); two-point tries and extra points read from play text; totals left out

college_players.json.source: ESPN college box scores via sportsdataverse-data releases (https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases) (espn_cfb_player_box), positions from cfbfastR-data rosters
college_players.json.holes: full tackles and sacks only 2024-2025; no FCS, D2, D3; data-era bests are not the all-time NCAA record book

college_people.json.source: sportsdataverse-data releases (https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases) (cfb_recruits, cfb_team_info, cfb_team_portal, cfb_returning_production, espn_cfb_coach_tendencies) and cfbfastR-data rosters
college_people.json.holes: no offers, visits or commit dates (247Sports, On3); recruits matched to hometowns by name (73%); CFBD's year-in-school coding is messy before 2019; head coaches only for about 115-125 FBS teams a year

college_recruiting_classes.csv.holes: class strength by counts and average ESPN grade, not a recruiting service's class ranking

memory_checks.json.source: nflverse-data rosters and trades, nfldata games.csv, sportsdataverse-data cfb_schedules (ESPN)
memory_checks.json.holes: Nothing before 1999 (NFL) or 2001 (college); rosters list a player's last number of the season, so a mid-season change shows once.
